name: tsasm
description: The tsAsm assembler's language: syntax colouring from the grammar and the assembly, the projects' errors in the Problems panel, the code not assembled faded, go to a definition, hovers, references, completion and signature help, rename, folding and the outline, the listing beside a file, and links to the files a source includes.

tsasm.project.markdownDescription: The project files to assemble, relative to the workspace folder: `"build/game.yaml"`, or a list. Left empty, every YAML file with an `input.source` is one.

tsasm.format.opcodeColumn.markdownDescription: Formatting: the column, from 0, of the mnemonics, directives and macro calls, rounded up to a tab stop with tabs. A block's body is one level further.

tsasm.format.operandColumn.markdownDescription: Formatting: the column, from 0, of the operands, rounded up to a tab stop with tabs. A block's body is one level further.

tsasm.format.commentColumn.markdownDescription: Formatting: the column, from 0, of the comments ending a line, rounded up to a tab stop with tabs. A comment alone on its line stays where it is.

tsasm.format.indentBlocks.markdownDescription: Formatting: indent the body of a `.macro`, `.proc`, `.function`, `.if`, `.repeat` or `.for` one level, its labels staying at the line's start. A namespace's body isn't indented.

semanticTokenModifiers.description: A local label: `:loop`, with the prefix `.option local.prefix` sets.
An anonymous label, or a reference to one: `:`, `:-`, `:++`.
